text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby demonstrates her formidable 
ability. The crowd erupts with excitement, 
pinning their hopes on her conquering the 
Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer reflects on her running. That 
lightning-fast speed might just allow her 
to thrive in sprint races as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In any case, next up is the first leg of 
the Triple Tiara—the Oka Sho, a race 
Daiichi Ruby's mother once won. She must 
face the challenge without giving in to 
the mounting pressure.
